title: FBI Tells Its Employees to Assume Hackers Have Their Personal Data
summary: An internal memo warned FBI staff that ShinyHunters, the group claiming it hacked the bureau's jobs site, may hold their private details.

title: Bitget Hacker Turns to Zcash Privacy Pool After Near Rejects $50M in Swaps
summary: The attacker behind the $387.5 million Bitget heist has started hiding about $3.8 million in ZEC inside Zcash's Ironwood pool, after Near Intents turned their swaps away.

title: Bitget Says Attacker Exploited Third-Party Security Product Flaw to Steal $388M
summary:
